hints.title: First Decreasing Inversion
hints.text: To make the string lexicographically smaller as early as possible, greedily swap the first adjacent pair where s[i] > s[i + 1] and both have the same parity.

hints.title: Parity Equivalence
hints.text: Two digits have the same parity if (int(s[i]) - int(s[i + 1])) % 2 == 0.

hints.title: Single Swap Termination
hints.text: Perform exactly one swap at the earliest matching index and return the modified string immediately.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan is already minimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the earliest inversion of identical parity yields the optimal lexicographical reduction.
